title: Continuity failover and recovery recipe domain types
intent: Define a unified domain contract for failover and recovery recipes so later continuity engines can validate and execute event-sourced recipe definitions.
observed_behavior: No continuity recipe domain model existed before this change.
intended_behavior: The domain package exposes one ContinuityRecipe type with failover/recovery kinds, optional recovery/manual trigger semantics, ordered recipe steps, source event metadata, and validation for required recipe identity and supported step actions.
